values.note: Dakota County Parks: standard electric (30/50 amp) sites $35 a night, water and electric (30/50 amp) $39, plus tax. $8 non-refundable reservation fee per site; full payment at booking; cancellations more than 48 hours out refunded less the $8 fee. Six people per site at most.

fees.source: https://dakotacountymn.gov/parks/parks-trails/lake-byllesby/lake-byllesby-campground ('Prices do not include taxes unless otherwise noted', 'Non-refundable reservation fee per site per reservation: $8', 'Water and electric (30/50 amp) sites: $39 per night', 'Standard electric (30/50 amp) sites: $35 per night', 'Maximum six people per campsite'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Reserve online (Dakota County WebTrac); 2027 reservations open Thursday, March 11 at 9 a.m. All campers need a reservation and check in at the campground office on arrival. Three-night minimum on Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends; 14 nights at most in any 30 days. Check-in after 2 p.m., check-out noon.

values.note: 83 sites: west 1-17 and central 18-46 water/electric, east 47-83 electric only. Every site has a 60-ft paved parking pad; the RV plus any towed vehicle must fit on the pad. Sites 1-8 and 18-46 take no tents. Pull-through sites are one-way.

note: Dakota County regional park campground on Lake Byllesby Reservoir in the Cannon River Valley, near the Cannon Valley Trail; swimming beach, boat launches and a paved lakeside trail. The west sites (1-17) back onto open grass and the paved lakeside trail, about 30 m from the water; the central row (18-46) has the campground road on its lake side. Use Harry Avenue: Gerlach Way (from 295th Street) is not a through road and has no clearance for RVs and trailers. --Claude
summary: Dakota County campground page and map read: 83 sites (stored 57), water/electric $39 and electric $35 30/50-amp plus tax, $8 reservation fee, WebTrac online booking (2027 opens March 11), 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night limit, 60-ft paved pads, one-way pull-throughs, showers, store, dump. No sewer site on any page or map, so the derived sewer: true is cleared. Season not stated (left). Lakefront holds only for the west row 1-17.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, checked hard): keep lakefront WITH A CAVEAT naming sites 1-17, or treat as lakeview if the paved trail counts as a separating strip. On imagery the West row (sites 1-17, back-in angled pads from about 44.5124,-92.9488 to 44.5134,-92.9471, per the county map) ends in open grass; between the pad ends and the water there is only the narrow paved lakeside trail and a riprap/brush shore band, ~25-35 m from pad end to the water, no tree screen and no road. The Central row (18-46, about 44.5134,-92.9465 to 44.5137,-92.9440) has the campground's own road between the pads and the shore (~25-30 m to water), so those are lakeview under the loop-road rule; the East sites 47-83 are inland behind the central rows and the office area. Reviewer's call: the only thing between sites 1-17 and the water is a public paved trail, which the About-panel wording ('no road, parking lot, day-use area or screen of trees') does not list.
Site count changed 57 -> 83 (the county map numbers 1-83, all RV-capable; the old note's '35 RV sites plus 22 tent sites' does not match the current page).
Hookups: sewer cleared (null). The old note's 'full-hookup pull-throughs' is not on the page or map; only water/electric and electric-only sites are listed.

Season: the page says only 'Lake Byllesby Campground is closed for the 2026 season'; no open/close dates (over-the-phone changes go to the county before May 1 and to the campground office from May 1). Stored derived season 05-01..10-31 'Approximate' left alone.

Phone 651-480-7770 matches the page (campground office).
